question: Find the value of [(12 div 4) timesleft{(12)/(3)+(5)/(3) times(7-4)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

**[(12 div 4) timesleft{(12)/(3)+(5)/(3) times(7-4)right}] **

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

Preference will be given on the basis of the letter coming first in the word Bodmas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f64c9f79d77b59f47195df405b394d1389881df31e18c68888ff4c37e1e42e.png] 

**Calculation:**

[(12 div 4) timesleft{(12)/(3)+(5)/(3) times(7-4)right}] 

= [(12 div 4) timesleft{(12)/(3)+(5)/(3) times(3)right}] 

= [(12 div 4) timesleft{4+5right}] 

= [(12 ÷ 4) × 9]

= 3 × 9

= 27

**Thus, the required value is 27.**

**Hence,** the correct answer is option 4.
